subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Nattaya Mukherjee is a Thai ethnomusicologist.
• Ethnomusicologists study music in its cultural context.
• Thai classical music is among the least documented musical traditions in Southeast Asia.
• Thai classical music was first formally notated in the early twentieth century.
• Mukherjee is known for her research on piphat ensemble repertoire.
prompt: The student wants to provide an example of an ethnomusicologist whose research focuses on Thai classical music. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: The research done on piphat ensemble repertoire exemplifies the work ethnomusicologists do to advance our understanding of musical traditions.
choices.B: Ethnomusicologist Nattaya Mukherjee is known for her research on piphat ensemble repertoire.
choices.C: By studying piphat ensemble repertoire — to name just one example — ethnomusicologists can learn more about Thai classical music.
choices.D: Thai classical music is a tradition that ethnomusicologists are still working to document.

explanation:
Choice B is the best answer. The sentence provides an example of an ethnomusicologist whose research focuses on Thai classical music, identifying Nattaya Mukherjee as an ethnomusicologist known for her research on piphat ensemble repertoire, a form of Thai classical music.

Why C is incorrect:

Choice C is incorrect. While the sentence mentions ethnomusicologists studying piphat ensemble repertoire, it doesn't provide a specific example of an ethnomusicologist.
